name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2026-07-14, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.50 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
